description: This file contains helper functions related to color space management in PDF processing, specifically handling RGB and CMYK color modes, ensuring color mode consistency, and comparing CMYK colors within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: ColorSpaceHelper
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for color space validation and comparison within PDF processing.

methods.name: EnsureColorMode
methods.description: Checks whether a color matches a specified color mode (RGB or CMYK), converting if necessary, or throwing an exception if incompatible.

methods.name: EnsureColorMode (overload)
methods.description: Checks whether a color matches the color mode specified in the PDF document's options.

methods.name: IsEqualCmyk
methods.description: Determines if two CMYK colors are equal based on their CMYK components.
